name: primeline-parakeet (German Parakeet)
purpose: 600M ASR model optimized for high-precision German transcription: subtitles, meeting minutes, call-center analytics, accessibility (card).

license.name: CC-BY-4.0
license.notes: HF tag cc-by-4.0, no LICENSE file in the repo; derived from Parakeet v3 (CC-BY-4.0). The CC BY 4.0 legal code was read in the Fluid Speech Pro repo; attribution to NVIDIA and primeLine needed.

benchmarks.name: German avg WER (Tuda-De, MLS, Common Voice 19)
benchmarks.variant: BF16; vs v3 base 3.64, Whisper large-v3 3.28, turbo 3.64

benchmarks.name: FLEURS German WER (transcribe.cpp port)
benchmarks.variant: GGUF Q8_0; equal to the NeMo reference 5.98 (measured by the transcribe.cpp authors)

weaknesses: Other languages may degrade (TEDx French worse with windowed attention)
Small community: about 1.1k downloads for the original repo
soft.maturity: Small German vendor (primeLine); its whisper-large-v3-turbo-german has 27k downloads.

user_reports.summary: German users: the model never outputs the sharp s and always writes "ss" (e.g. "gross", "Gruesse"), which also breaks the closing formula; three users confirm, fine-tune requested.

tona_fit.reason: Strongest German-specialised small model (vendor table 2.95 avg vs 3.64 for Parakeet v3 and 3.28 for Whisper large-v3), CC-BY-4.0, 0.6B, every class. Known flaw: no sharp s. Not on the independent leaderboard, so confirm on our German audio; Tona has no audio module (side engine).

open_questions: Training data and date not on the card
Evaluation setup of the vendor table not described
Fix for the missing sharp s: fine-tune or post-processing rule (check against Fluid Speech Pro)
